subject: CYCLE-2 TEST-RESULT: BackupReceipt schema + semantic validator closes Cycle-1 proof gaps
body: Cycle 2 redesign adds a required semantic-validator identifier and a companion deterministic validator. 13/13 adversarial tests PASS. The validator now rejects expected/observed digest mismatch, byte-count mismatch, verification before snapshot creation, receipt creation before remote verification, duplicate part paths, stale idempotency keys after target/commit change, unverified remote bytes, lineage conflict, post-hash mutation, empty parts, and the existing NOT_EXECUTED candidate. A structurally and semantically valid synthetic receipt passes. No live Git backup was performed, so this is MODEL+LOCAL_TEST evidence only; it closes the normative schema-design gap but does not close Shadow Trial gap #5 (authorized remote backup execution).

service.blocker: live remote backup verification remains unauthorized/unrun; schema cannot itself prove remote bytes without adapter evidence
